description: DevMem: records Claude Code sessions in projects switched on with /devmem:setup and adds relevant earlier work to their prompts. Does nothing in any other project.

hooks.command: set +eu; set -- "\" <#" --plugin-hook SessionStart; shift; trap - EXIT; trap - ERR 2>/dev/null; f="$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/bin/devmem"; if [ -n "${BASH_VERSION-}" ] && ! shopt -oq posix; then . "$f"; else (. "$f"); fi; exit 0 #>; $r = $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT; if ($r -match '[%^]') { try { Add-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $env:TEMP 'devmem_hook_errors.log') -Value ((Get-Date).ToString() + ' devmem plugin hook SessionStart: the plugin folder path holds % or ^, which cmd cannot pass safely; nothing recorded: ' + $r) } catch {} } else { try { & "$r\bin\devmem.cmd" --plugin-hook SessionStart } catch {} }; exit 0
